entries.title: Any crewmate can save knowledge you ask to keep
entries.body: You can ask any crewmate to save an article it reads, including in a later reply and on a task without a project. It saves the article's ideas and findings with short quotes and the link. Every crewmate can now read your saved personal context and sources, including ones saved for another project. A crewmate saves personal context only from your own words, and looks things up only when the work needs them.
entries.noPicture: This changes what crewmates can read and save, not the Knowledge browser or another screen.
